title: Moon Tide
meta_description: Welcome to Moon Tide, a magnificent Seacrest cottage that strikes a beautiful balance between peaceful suburban living and laidback beachy elegance. With an oversized swimming pool, 3 private bedrooms, easy beach access, and 4 beach cruiser bikes.
description_expanded: DescriptionWelcome to Moon Tide, a magnificent Seacrest cottage that strikes a beautiful balance between peaceful suburban living and laidback beachy elegance. Featuring serene surroundings, an oversized, screened-in swimming pool, three private bedrooms, and a lovely, stylish interior design, Moon Tide is the place to unwind and unplug when you want to return to nature yet still immerse yourself in total luxury.The charming cottage-style curb appeal features a modern front door that opens directly into the open KITCHEN and DINING spaces. The first thing that will catch your eye is the vibrant, vintage-inspired mosaic tile design, which flows beautifully throughout the entire home. The open kitchen features both white and matte black cabinetry, as well as a gorgeous marble countertop and backsplash. Premier appliances include an in-drawer microwave, a dishwasher, a wine fridge, a full-size fridge, and a sleek electric range. In the DINING SPACE, there’s an upholstered bench and plenty of extra seating for everyone.Around the corner from the open dining space is the inviting LIVING AREA, with large, bright windows overlooking the backyard. Here, you’ll find a plush sectional sofa and large HDTV, plus a sliding glass door leading out to the resort-style swimming pool.Down the hallway, the first of three bedrooms is the PRIMARY SUITE, which includes an elegant wicker headboard and a luxe queen-size bed. In the subway-tiled ENSUITE BATHROOM, there’s a shower combo and a marble vanity. Next to the bathroom is a LAUNDRY NOOK with a stacked washer and dryer. The SECOND GUEST BEDROOM houses a comfy queen-size bed, while the THIRD GUEST BEDROOM has a twin-over-twin-size bunk bed. Another FULL BATHROOM has a step-in shower.Head outside to the spacious landscaped yard, where you’ll enjoy a COVERED TERRACE with a grill and outdoor dining area, a FIRE PIT that’s ideal for evening cocktails and conversation, and a full-size BOCCE COURT for friendly family competitions. All this, plus the oversized, screened-in SWIMMING POOL elevates Moon Tide into the upper echelon of exquisite places to call home during your next 30A coastal getaway.Located in the darling community of Seacrest, Moon Tide is only a short distance away from the award-winning emerald coast beaches, and the four beach cruiser bicycles that are included with this home make it so easy to get to the sand and surf. When you want to explore the rest of this charming beach town, you’ll also be close to lots of local restaurants and shopping options.Home HighlightsVibrant, vintage-inspired designLarge private swimming pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)Close to the beach & Camp Creek Golf ClubSpacious and open layoutWasher and dryer4 complimentary beach cruiser bikesPropane grill (with 2 tanks)Complete Clean Bedding ProgramBocce ball courtOutdoor showerMAIN FLOOR: (Sleeps 6)PRIMARY BEDROOM: queen-size bed, ENSUITE BATHROOM with Shower (Sleeps 2)GUEST BEDROOM: queen-size bed, (Sleeps 2)GUEST BEDROOM: twin-over-twin-size bunk bed (Sleeps 2)LIVING AREAKITCHENSWIMMING POOLLAUNDRY ROOMFULL BATHROOM, Shower/tub combo
